requestedPairCheck.status: disputed official-source observation; NOT confirmed for runtime. MDS directly lists 3120/3310 RUB for 89–646, but its own 58–646 row (3290/3520) conflicts with the current Avtodor tariff-page 58-origin cell (3890/4580) for the corresponding 58–646/PVP58→PVP647 span. Resolve which source/version and charging scope governs before use.
requestedPairCheck.method: Capture direct operator-published route cells as evidence, but quarantine for runtime while the operator pages conflict. Never derive the requested amount by subtracting PVP58 origin fares.
requestedPairCheck.sourceEvidence: MDS tariff page, Category I (<2 m, 2+ axles), row 89-646 km: 3,120 RUB for workdays and 3,310 RUB for weekends/holidays; duplicate day/night columns show same Category-I amount for this pair.
requestedPairCheck.mappingNote: Yandex markers 88 and 648 km map to operator tariff endpoints PVP89 and route km646 / PVP647. The MDS table labels this published vector 89-646 km.
requestedPairCheck.paymentNote: Base tariff without transponder per matrix policy. MDS tariff page shows Category-I fares; its transponder-discount notice applies to Categories III and IV only. Effective date not stated in captured page.

sourceConflict.comparison: MDS and Avtodor publish conflicting amounts for the same listed 58–646 km span; therefore the MDS 89–646 cell is preserved as a direct observation but not accepted as current confirmed fare.

requestedPairCheck.effectiveDateNote: MDS table date not stated. Its displayed fare is disputed and likely stale: OССП announced changed M-11 tariffs on km58–543 effective 2026-09-04; the current Avtodor detailed PDF was issued 2026-09-04. Do not infer the updated 89–646 price from the previous MDS cell.

userReported58to679Cell.reconciliation: The same 3900/4200 figures occur in the Avtodor official row but are the Mon–Thu payment-mode columns (3900 with transponder; 4200 without). Current official row then gives 4690 with and 4940 without transponder for Fri–Sun. The reported calendar grouping is not how the official table defines these amounts.
userReported58to679Cell.disposition: recorded as a report of m11-neva.ru UI output; not used as a km58–679 fare cell. User selected the current official Avtodor tariff table as the authoritative source when available. Retain current Avtodor cells; treat the UI output as an unverified scope/day/payment-setting diagnostic, not a competing approved tariff.

sourcePriorityDecision.decision: Use Order No. 274 dated 2026-09-03 as the authoritative source for all M-11 km58–679 Category-I direct PVP-pair fares.
sourcePriorityDecision.precedence: If any tariff overview, website calculator, Yandex estimate, or older source conflicts with a direct cell in Order No. 274, retain the discrepancy for audit but use the Order No. 274 cell.
sourcePriorityDecision.payment: Use the common matrix applicable to cash, bank card, and listed transponders; calculator policy remains the base fare without transponder, and the order does not distinguish that payment option in the matrix.
